players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: He is ruled out for Week 10 at Green Bay (Grade 2 hamstring) after missing every practice this week. ESPN's injury page as of Nov. 14 says Minnesota is targeting a Week 12 return vs. Atlanta on Nov. 29, but Kirk Cousins is starting in his place.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: Final Week 10 injury reports (Nov. 14) list Minnesota as starting Cousins on Sunday, Nov. 15 at Green Bay with Kyler Murray out. The Vikings reacquired him from Las Vegas at the Nov. 10 deadline for a 2027 third-round pick.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: He is ruled out for Week 10 at Las Vegas (quad, ribs) after not practicing all week. Seattle has a Week 11 bye, so Week 12 is the earliest he can return.

players.name: Drew Lock
players.note: He was removed from the injury report and starts Sunday, Nov. 15 at Las Vegas with Sam Darnold out. Seattle's Week 11 bye means this is likely a one-game spot start.

players.name: Fernando Mendoza
players.note: The No. 1 overall pick makes his first NFL regular-season start Sunday, Nov. 15 at home vs. Seattle, after Las Vegas named him the starter Nov. 10 following the Kirk Cousins trade.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: He starts Week 10 vs. the Rams and should keep the job going forward because Gardner Minshew went on IR Nov. 10 with a season-ending elbow (UCL) injury.

players.name: Deshaun Watson
players.note: He cleared the concussion protocol on Nov. 7 and the Browns confirmed he starts Sunday, Nov. 15 vs. Houston. One report says a loss could reopen the competition with Shedeur Sanders after the bye.

players.name: Shedeur Sanders
players.note: He is back on the bench for Week 10 after Cleveland named Deshaun Watson the starter on Nov. 11. He could get another chance if the Browns lose to Houston.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: Traded from Arizona to Baltimore before the Nov. 10 deadline, he is the Ravens' Week 10 starter with Lamar Jackson on IR. He hosts the Chargers on MNF, Nov. 16.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: He remains on IR after right thumb surgery and is likely out for the season. Jacoby Brissett starts for Baltimore on MNF, Nov. 16.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: He went on IR Nov. 10 with a groin injury and will miss at least four games. Kyle McCord starts Week 10 at Indianapolis, and Miami elevated QB Brady Cook as the backup on Nov. 14.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: He remains on IR with blood clots (DVT requiring blood thinners), and the latest update says he is likely out for the rest of 2026.

players.name: Joe Milton
players.note: The Eagles are on bye in Week 10. As of Nov. 11 they had not named a starter for Nov. 22 vs. Pittsburgh after Milton lost his first start 19-11 to the Giants, so Tanner McKee is still in the mix.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: He played through a hip injury on TNF Nov. 12 and threw for a career-high 293 yards in a 24-21 loss to Washington. He remains the Giants' starter with Jaxson Dart out for the season.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: He remains on IR and is reported as lost for the season. J.J. McCarthy is starting for the Giants.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.note: The Chiefs downgraded Walker to out for Week 10 at Atlanta with a late-week groin issue on Nov. 14. Adam Schefter reports they want to give him a week, which suggests a short-term absence.

players.name: Emmett Johnson
players.note: With Kenneth Walker III ruled out, Johnson is set to make his first NFL start Sunday, Nov. 15, against Atlanta. Kansas City also elevated Nate Carter from the practice squad.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery (groin) did not travel to Cleveland and was ruled out for Week 10 on Nov. 14, even though he reportedly practiced fully Friday. Houston elevated Dare Ogunbowale from the practice squad.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: The Patriots placed Henderson (illness) on injured reserve on Saturday, Nov. 14, so he will miss at least four more games. He was hospitalized with neurological symptoms in early November.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: Stevenson (knee) is officially active for the Nov. 15 game against Detroit in Munich after being listed questionable. He was limited Thursday and Friday and may not be at 100%, but Henderson's move to IR leaves him as the lead back.

players.name: Corey Kiner
players.note: After TreVeyon Henderson moved to IR on Nov. 14, Kiner and Lan Larison are New England's backups behind a less-than-full-strength Rhamondre Stevenson.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: Jacobs had surgery Friday, Nov. 13, on his fractured ring finger and is out for Week 10 against Minnesota. The Packers did not place him on IR in Saturday's moves, which points to a 2-3 week absence.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: With Josh Jacobs out after finger surgery, Johnson is the likely lead back against Minnesota on Nov. 15. Green Bay also activated Chris Brooks from IR on Nov. 14, which could take some of the work.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.note: The Saints activated Etienne (hamstring) from injured reserve on Saturday, Nov. 14, ahead of Week 10 against Carolina. He carries a questionable designation after practicing through the week.

players.name: Audric Estime
players.note: Etienne was activated from IR on Nov. 14, which cuts into Estime's Week 10 streaming appeal against Carolina. Estime was mainly a fill-in if Etienne stayed out.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: Spears (knee) practiced fully Friday, Nov. 13, after sitting Wednesday and being limited Thursday. He remains questionable for Week 10 against Jacksonville and is the Titans' only questionable player.

players.name: Zonovan Knight
players.note: Knight cleared the concussion protocol and is set to play Sunday, Nov. 15.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.note: Sleeper lists Brooks on injured reserve as of Nov. 15. He had been listed doubtful for Week 10 against New Orleans.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.note: Harvey (knee) remains on IR. Jonah Coleman's lead role makes a reduced workload likely when he returns.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Love (high ankle sprain) has been on IR since Nov. 3 and is expected to miss 4-5 weeks.

players.name: Demond Claiborne
players.note: Claiborne (knee) has been on injured reserve since Nov. 9.

players.name: Pat Freiermuth
players.note: The Steelers added Freiermuth (illness) to the injury report on Saturday, Nov. 14, and he is questionable for Sunday night's Week 10 game at Cincinnati, though he is expected to play through it. If he sits, Darnell Washington and Robert Tonyan would absorb the TE work, and Pittsburgh's inactives come out at 6:50 PM ET.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: Hockenson (wrist/chest) remains out for Week 10 at Green Bay after being ruled out on Friday, Nov. 13. Ben Yurosek and Gavin Bartholomew will handle the TE snaps, and how long the wrist injury will keep him out is still unclear.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (left knee PCL/MCL sprain) is out for Week 10 vs. San Francisco and is expected to miss multiple weeks. Brevyn Spann-Ford and Luke Schoonmaker should split the TE work.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson remains on IR and is out for Week 10 at Arizona after injuring his hamstring in practice. Sean McVay said he will miss "another couple weeks," so a return before late November is uncertain.

players.name: Tyler Warren
players.note: After the Nov. 10 trades of Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, Warren is Indianapolis' top passing-game option for Week 10, and backup TE Mo Alie-Cox was ruled out Nov. 13. Warren himself carries no injury designation.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Brown (ankle/knee) is officially questionable for the Nov 15 game vs. Detroit in Munich after three straight limited practices. On Nov 13 Mike Vrabel said he felt 'pretty good' about his chances, and Ian Rapoport reported Brown has a good chance to play.

players.name: DeMario Douglas
players.note: A.J. Brown is questionable but trending toward playing Nov 15 after practicing all week. That makes Douglas' expanded role from Nov 8 less secure.

players.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
players.note: Detroit's Nov 13 final report lists St. Brown questionable (ribs) for the Nov 15 game in Munich after limited practice. Reports call him likely to play.

players.name: Garrett Wilson
players.note: Wilson (concussion) is questionable for the Nov 15 game vs. Buffalo. Aaron Glenn said he is 'very hopeful' Wilson plays, and Wilson reportedly practiced fully Friday, Nov 13.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: Mitchell (knee) is questionable for the Nov 15 game vs. Buffalo, per the Jets' Nov 13 final report. If Garrett Wilson clears the concussion protocol, Mitchell would lose his lead-receiver role.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.note: Minnesota ruled Jennings (calf) out for the Nov 15 game at Green Bay after he missed all three practices. It will be his second straight missed game.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Addison was added to the report Friday, Nov 13, with a thumb injury and is questionable after a limited practice. Jauan Jennings and TJ Hockenson are both out, so Addison would see a heavy target share from Kirk Cousins if he plays.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: Boston (toe) is questionable for the Nov 15 game vs. Houston. Todd Monken said Nov 13 that he is 'trending in the right direction.'

players.name: Chris Bell
players.note: Miami listed Bell doubtful (knee) on Nov 13 for the Nov 15 game at Indianapolis after he missed Thursday's practice.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Tennessee ruled Tate (shoulder) out for the Nov 15 game vs. Jacksonville on Nov 13.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson (hamstring) was listed doubtful as of Nov 14 after missing practice Nov 12-13. A third straight missed game looks likely for the Chargers' Monday night game vs. Baltimore.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Samuel (hamstring) came off the injury report Nov 13 and will play vs. Dallas on Nov 15 after missing three games. Mike Evans (Achilles) is out, which opens up targets.

players.name: George Pickens
players.note: Pickens (hamstring) came off the injury report Nov 13 and is set to play vs. San Francisco on Nov 15 after being inactive Nov 8.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: On Nov 11 Shane Steichen said he is unsure whether Pierce (heel, IR since Week 3) will return in 2026 and would not give a timetable.

players.name: Deion Burks
players.note: After the Nov 10 trades of Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, Steichen said Nov 11 he is unsure Alec Pierce will return this season. That leaves Burks among the Colts' top receivers for the Nov 15 game vs. Miami.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: As of Nov 13 there was still no report of Aiyuk being activated, traded or released. San Francisco has until about Nov 23 to decide, and Keenan Allen was added Nov 10.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Smith (hamstring) has missed three straight games and Philadelphia is on bye in Week 10. The earliest he can return is Week 11.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Waddle (concussion, Nov 8) is in the protocol during Denver's Week 10 bye. He is aiming for the Nov 22 game vs. Las Vegas.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams remains on IR (hamstring) and is targeting a return around Weeks 12-13, after the Rams' Week 11 bye. The Rams' receiver room is thin with Puka Nacua on IR.

players.name: Cyrus Allen
players.note: Kansas City added Josh Downs at the Nov 10 deadline, which adds another target competitor. Xavier Worthy (hamstring) and Rashee Rice (knee) were on the Chiefs' Week 10 injury report.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans (Achilles tendinitis) did not practice this week and is ruled out for Sunday's Nov 15 game at Dallas.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: With Mike Evans ruled out for Nov 15 at Dallas, Allen should see meaningful snaps in his 49ers debut after being acquired from Indianapolis at the Nov 10 deadline.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.note: Harrison (hamstring) is ruled out on the final Week 10 injury report for Houston's Nov 15 game vs. Cleveland.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring) is ruled out for Sunday's Nov 15 game vs. Kansas City, his second straight missed game.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Cooper (ankle) is questionable for Week 10 on Nov 15 after limited practices; he missed time earlier this season with a high ankle sprain, so check inactives before kickoff.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.note: Worthy (hamstring) was a full participant on the Chiefs' Week 10 practice report and Andy Reid called him day-to-day ahead of Sunday's Nov 15 game at Atlanta. The Nov 10 trade for Josh Downs adds competition for targets.

players.name: Josh Downs
players.note: Kansas City acquired Downs from Indianapolis on Nov 10 for 2027 fourth- and fifth-round picks. He is set to debut Sunday, Nov 15 at Atlanta, likely in a limited role while he learns the offense.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.note: Minnesota reacquired Kirk Cousins at the Nov 10 deadline and he is expected to start Nov 15 at Green Bay with Kyler Murray out, reuniting Jefferson with his former QB.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Nacua (MCL/PCL sprains, turf toe) has been on IR since Nov 12. With the Rams' Week 11 bye, Week 15 is reportedly his earliest return.

players.name: Rashid Shaheed
players.note: Shaheed (knee) practiced fully this week after missing two games and is not on the final Week 10 injury report, so he is expected to play Nov 15.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey (back) was active but did not play in Week 9, and Jim Harbaugh called him day-to-day. The Chargers play Monday night, Nov 16 at Baltimore, so his status may not be settled before Sunday lineups lock.

players.name: Luther Burden III
players.note: Burden suffered a concussion Nov 8 vs. Tampa Bay and must clear the protocol; Chicago's Week 10 bye gives him extra time before Week 11.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.note: Pittman (foot) is eligible to come off IR but has not had his practice window opened, so he will not play Nov 15 vs. Cincinnati; reports point to a return after Pittsburgh's bye at the earliest.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson is out for the season with a neck fracture suffered Nov 8 vs. Seattle, announced Nov 9.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon on Oct 19 and is out for the 2026 season.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) has been on IR since Oct 19 and no practice window had been reported as of Nov 14.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Wilson (finger) remains on IR with no return date reported as of Nov 14.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: Lamar Jackson remains on IR and Flowers managed just 3.8 half-PPR points in the Nov 5 loss with a rookie at QB; his outlook stays poor until Jackson returns.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: Hill remains an unsigned free agent coming off ACL surgery with no signing reported as of mid-November, and the NFL says his matter remains under review under the personal conduct policy, so a signing team could face a suspension.
